title: 64DD fault jingle
notes: Scenario 4 of the C-R2.3 matrix. The 64DD fault jingle. STATUS: blocked / determinism
unproven. OPEN ITEM (contract C-R2.3): leo_fault_dd.c gates its retry behavior on a
WALL-CLOCK read; that timing determines when/whether the fault jingle plays and for how long,
which is a nondeterminism source the audioRandom + gRandSeed pins do NOT cover. Do NOT bless a
golden for this scenario until the leo_fault_dd.c retry-gating entry has been traced and its
wall-clock dependency either pinned or ruled out of the audio-affecting path. The autoinput
placeholder here only exists to trigger the fault condition once that trace is done.
